title: You test your own parachute by jumping off the Eiffel Tower

backgrounds.tower: view from the first platform of the Eiffel Tower in 1912, riveted iron railing and wooden deck in the foreground, Paris rooftops and the Seine far below, misty winter morning
backgrounds.workshop: cluttered 1910s Paris tailor's workshop, sewing machine, rolls of fabric, mannequins, hanging coats, wooden floor in the foreground
backgrounds.street: Paris street in 1912 at the foot of the Eiffel Tower, cobblestones, gas lamps, Belle Epoque buildings, cold morning, open pavement in the foreground
backgrounds.heaven: heaven made of fluffy pastel clouds, golden light rays, soft pink and blue sky, cloud floor in the foreground

lines.text: What if you tested your own parachute by jumping off the Eiffel Tower?
You're a tailor, and you've invented a parachute you can wear.
Every dummy you throw drops straight down. Splat.
You told us you'd use a dummy!
lines.speaker: cop

lines.text: Cameras roll. You hesitate for forty seconds. Then you jump. It never opens.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.

experiment.hook: WOULD YOU JUMP? cold open on the tower in the parachute suit
